data.text: We are updating all our Resonance quantum computers to the new major IQM OS release. First, we will upgrade Emerald on Monday, October 19th, followed by Garnet and Sirius on Wednesday, October 21st. You are strongly advised to update the client-side packages as described below while expecting downtimes from 2:00 UTC until approx. 15:00 UTC during those days. Please read also the updated package documentation on https://docs.iqm.tech/
Package Versions

Python v3.12 and v3.13 are officially supported. Below are the version requirements for iqm-client and iqm-pulla users (public packages). Install in a new virtual environment with the pinned constraints file, e.g.: uv pip install "iqm-client[qiskit,cirq]" -c constraints-iqm-qccsw-4.7.0.txt

data.text: IQM OS 4.7.0
Upgrade iqm-client to >=36.0.0.
Pulse-level access has moved into iqm-client itself and several packages now require NumPy ≥2.2.
What's new:
- Pulse-level circuit access is now built directly into IQMClient — no more separate iqm-pulla install. QIR circuit import is also available via iqm_client.qir_utils.

- Qiskit transpilation is more robust: every combination of final-RZ handling, barrier handling, and MOVE-gate routing now has a working scheduling plugin and the transpiler now automatically filters out any qubit missing PRX support instead of trying to use it.
- Error mitigation (REMWorkflow) now reports the underlying QPU job IDs it submitted, so mitigated results can be traced back to the raw runs that produced them.
- And much more behind the scenes!
Worth a quick check during the upgrade:

- Pulla, IQMClient.submit_run_request/create_run_request, and IQMBackend/IQMSampler.create_run_request are all removed — replace with IQMClient.submit_circuit_job/create_circuit_job_definition (the renamed CircuitJobDefinition still works under its old name RunRequest, so this part isn't urgent).
- Qiskit no longer drops final RZ gates by default during transpilation (doesn't affect measurement results, only the circuit's unitary) — pass remove_final_rzs=True if you relied on the old default.

- If you use readout error mitigation, REMResults.mitigated_counts is replaced by REMResults.mitigated_distributions (quasi-probabilities, not integer counts) — and there is a related correctness fix for mitigated results with strategy="NONE" or without readout twirling.

data.text: iqm-client 35.0.0
⚠️ Breaking Changes

items.content: URLs containing the quantum computer name (e.g. https://resonance.meetiqm.com/garnet) — pass the name via the quantum_computer parameter instead.
URLs with the :timeslot suffix — use use_timeslot=True when submitting a job.
https://cocos.resonance.meetiqm.com URLs — use https://resonance.iqm.tech instead.
Deprecated URL formats removed. IQMClient.__init__ no longer accepts:
Insecure HTTP rejected. IQMClient now raises an error for plain HTTP requests to remote hosts. Use https:// URLs.

data.text: Features

items.content: Qrisp support. A new iqm.qrisp_iqm package allows executing Qrisp circuits on IQM quantum computers (install with iqm-client[qrisp]). Includes a passes module with VF2++ layout (vf2pp_layout) and SABRE-based routing/layout passes (plasma_route, plasma_layout), plus a iqm.qrisp.qec module for streamlined QEC experiments on IQM hardware.
Environment variable configuration. iqm_server_url and quantum_computer can now be set via IQM_SERVER_URL and IQM_QUANTUM_COMPUTER environment variables (explicit parameters take priority).
quantum_computer_name property added to IQMClient, used to initialize IQMBackend.name.
Security improvements in _IQMServerClient: authorization headers are stripped on plain HTTP calls, and automatic redirects for mutating requests are blocked.
New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all, cirq-pin-iqm, cirq-pin-all, cli-pin-iqm, cli-pin-all, qiskit-pin-iqm, qiskit-pin-all.
pydantic pinned to minor version 2.12.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: Switched from pinned requests dependency to a range.
Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

data.text: iqm-pulla 14.0.0
⚠️ Breaking Changes

items.content: iqm.cpc.compiler.compiler imports changed.
EXA no longer attempts to fix loci of a locus mapping based on gate symmetry when building the settings tree — each GateImplementation is now expected to use the correct locus mapping.
FLUX_PULSED_QUBITS_2QB_MAPPING now returns only the numerically sorted locus when both qubits have fast flux.
Heralding discarding all shots now raises PostSelectionError instead of RuntimeError.
Removed obsolete classes: MeasurementMode, CircuitBoundaryMode, CircuitExecutionOptions, and the circuit_operations_to_cpc function.

data.text: Features

items.content: Compiler performance improvements: settings are no longer deepcopied at the start of compilation, and settings-to-calibration-data conversion is optimized. CircuitCompilationResult can store settings as a dict instead of setting nodes.
Drive crosstalk compiler pass (apply_drive_crosstalk) added as the last schedule-to-schedule pass (disabled by default).
Triple fast flux CZ gate property added, analogous to the AC Stark implementations.
Standard EXA-style post-processing now supports Move_Measure_Composite implementation.
New method Compiler.get_schedule_builder for debugging.
CircuitExecutionResult now uses its own types.
Bumps iqm-qiskit-qir dependency for Python 3.14 support.
New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all, notebook-pin-iqm, notebook-pin-all, qir-pin-iqm, qir-pin-all, qiskit-pin-iqm, qiskit-pin-all.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: Fixed Qiskit post-processing breaking when using the reset instruction.
Counter post-processing readout mode now works correctly with MOVE-MEASURE.
Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

data.text: iqm-benchmarks 2.60.0
Features

New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all, examples-pin-iqm, examples-pin-all.
Updated more-itertools dependency version range.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: timeslot mode enabled for IQM Resonance.
Added active_reset_cycles to circuit compilation options.
Fixed calibration data retrieval.
Fixed QScore benchmark for higher QAOA depths.
Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

data.text: iqm-error-reduction-tools 0.2.0
🎉 First public release!
Features

items.content: Readout Error Mitigation (REM) framework, including a high-level REM workflow API for one-call end-to-end execution and a REC (Readout Error Characterization) framework with support for saving and reusing characterization data across runs.
Circuit twirling framework for turning coherent errors into stochastic noise, with configurable twirling strategies

data.text: iqm-pulse 14.0.0
⚠️ Breaking Changes

items.content: QuantumOp now uses aggregator_class attribute for factorizable operations (the old factorizable is retained as a derived property).
GateImplementation.special_implementation removed.
ScheduleBuilder.__init__ signature changed to use StationProperties (contents also changed).
Removed iqm.pulse.playlist.channel.get_channel_properties and iqm.pulse.playlist.get_channel_properties_from_station_settings.

GateImplementation.get_locus_mapping_name and GateImplementation.get_custom_locus_mapping removed — locus mappings are now always created by GateImplementation.get_locus_mapping. Locus mapping names no longer exist.

data.text: Features

items.content: New gate coupler_move with implementations CouplerMOVE_CRF and CouplerMOVE_CRF_CRF.
TripleFluxPulseGate — new gate implementation class for two-qubit gates with fast flux on both qubits and the coupler, including a Slepian pulse shape subclass.
Move_Measure_Composite implementation for measuring components without probe lines (e.g. computational resonators).
MeasureBoxes class for uniform handling (including multiplexing) of measure implementation return types. All measure implementations now return MeasureBoxes.
QBBias_Measure_Constant — new measure implementation with fast flux bias during readout.
DriveCrossTalk — experimental gate implementation for drive crosstalk compensation, holding the crosstalk matrix in sparse form.
modulation_frequency parameter exposed in PRX_CustomWaveForms and PRX_CustomWaveFormsSX for off-resonant DRAG pulse calibration.
GateImplementations can now build station-properties-aware setting nodes via build_setting_node.
has_virtual_drive attribute added to StationProperties.
New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: CompositeGates that do not need calibration can no longer be instantiated for arbitrary loci.
Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

data.text: iqm-qaoa 2.0.0
⚠️ Breaking Changes

items.content: BQM variables can now use any custom labels internally; orig_to_new_labels and new_to_orig_labels dictionaries removed.
Removed helper functions relabel_bqm_cqm_variables and relabel_graph_nodes.
LogQubit changed from int alias to dimod.Variable alias.
allow_custom_var_names parameter removed from QUBOInstance.
original_labels parameter removed from all fix_variables methods.
Classical solvers (greedy_max_cut, goemans_williamson, greedy_mis, bron_kerbosch) now accept problem instances, not nx.Graph.
ham_graph_to_ham_operator reworked to ham_bqm_to_ham_operator with changed signature.
cnot_list is now a read-only property (returns compute_cnots + uncompute_cnots).
Default build_qiskit output changed — remove_cnots_first_layer=True is the new default, producing fewer CNOTs in the first QAOA layer. Pass remove_cnots_first_layer=False for old behaviour.
rz() after uncomputation now raises RuntimeError.
Parity twine network router rewritten using CircuitSynthesis formalism; type aliases Parity, LineQubit, PTNLayer and classes LineMappingPTN, LineRoutingPTN removed.
Estimators/samplers API unified: single estimate/sample method dispatching on input type (QUBOQAOA vs HUBOQAOA). Methods moved from QUBOQAOA to parent QAOA.
EstimatorBackend and SamplerBackend no longer abstract; override private methods instead.
train method kwargs now go directly to scipy.minimize.
Sampler backends accept transpiler kwargs at construction time.

data.text: Features

items.content: HUBO support — new HUBOInstance, HUBOQAOA, qiskit_circuit_hubo, rnz helper, and ham_bp_to_ham_operator transform. EstimatorStateVector and EstimatorFromSampler support both QUBO and HUBO.
New ParityMapping and CircuitSynthesis classes for constructing quantum circuits by adding CNOT and RZ gates.
CNOT-count reduction on the first QAOA layer via remove_cnots_first_layer.
remove_cnots mode for the phase separator.
Explicit compute/uncompute separation via begin_uncompute() method and computing property.
Separate CNOT tracking: compute_cnots and uncompute_cnots.
ProblemInstance gains variables and original_variables attributes.
New uncompute_parities method and CNOTStep nested class in CircuitSynthesis.
_estimate_hubo added to EstimatorQUIMB.
fix_constraint_violation_bitstring method and greedy_mwis solver for MaximumWeightISInstance.
greedy_mis solver now accepts an optional seed.
New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all, notebook-pin-iqm, notebook-pin-all.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: Various typing fixes (list → Iterable, LogEdge → HardEdge, LogQubit → LineQubit).
random package replaced by numpy.random in several places.
Fixed EstimatorQUIMB crash when Hamiltonian has no constant term.
CrystalQPUFromBackend now pulls gate fidelities from Qiskit backend instead of IQMClient.get_observation_quality_metrics.
Fixed restore_fixed_variable_bitstring and draw_problem to respect variable label ordering.
quality method of HUBOInstance/QUBOInstance now validates bitstring length.
Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

data.text: iqm-qubit-selector 1.1.0
Features

items.content: Improved general documentation and example notebook.
Removed deprecated iqm_server_url usage.
New optional dependency groups: pin-iqm, pin-all, notebook-pin-iqm, notebook-pin-all.

data.text: Bug Fixes

items.content: Domain changed from meetiqm.com to iqm.tech.

Qrisp integration is delivered through iqm-client (install with iqm-client[qrisp]):

system_notifications.title: IQM Error Reduction Tools release
system_notifications.lead: A new client-side library to perform error reduction on IQM devices.

data.text:
As part of the new IQM OS 4.6, we have released iqm-error-reduction-tools, a comprehensive toolkit for error reduction in quantum computing applications.

The library docs can be found in https://docs.iqm.tech/4.6/iqm-error-reduction-tools/index.html .
The open-source library contains two complementary techniques that work together to pull more accurate results out of IQM quantum computers.

The first is readout error mitigation, which reduces the impact of measurement errors, also taking into account potential correlations between qubits. It also comes with a handy utility that makes mitigation considerably more efficient when the user only cares about low-weight observables, which covers a lot of practical use cases.
The second tool is a circuit randomization technique, which generates logically-equivalent variants of a target circuit and averages their results, turning detrimental coherent errors (e.g. systematic over-rotations) into more manageable stochastic noise. What sets our approach apart from established twirling techniques is that it adds no extra gates: instead of inserting new single-qubit operations (and the noise they bring), it only modifies gates already present in the circuit.
Stay tuned as we will continue adding more error reduction and error mitigation techniques to the iqm-error-reduction-tools library in future releases!

system_notifications.title: Access token management update
system_notifications.lead: Introducing multiple access tokens and added security

data.text: We have updated how API tokens work in IQM Resonance. You can now create up to 10 access tokens per account and assign each one specific scopes, making it easier to follow a least-privilege approach to token permissions. Your existing tokens are listed on your profile page, where you can also create new access tokens.
Breaking change for organisation admins using the GraphQL API

Existing tokens will no longer have access to the GraphQL API. This change promotes the best practice of separating token scopes between routine job submission and advanced GraphQL integration. To continue using the GraphQL API, create a new token on your profile page with the "Account management" scope.

Please note that all our quantum computers will be unavailable during the upgrade between approximately 2:00 UTC and 14:00 UTC.  The IQM OS 4.5 release brings these major client-facing changes:

items.content: First release of iqm-qubit-selector for crystal topology. Used for transpiling a circuit to the best qubits.

data.text: 🔧 IQM Pulla Changes

items.content: Migrate code to use the new "Pulla MQE" classes instead of the removed old Pulla and CPC classes.

Replace the obsolete station_control_result_to_qiskit utility with the restored sweep_job_to_qiskit.

data.text: Full list of changes can be found at https://docs.meetiqm.com.

system_notifications.lead: Learn more about the update

data.text: On Monday December 8th 2025, all IQM Resonance systems will be upgraded to IQM OS 4.4.

Please note that all our quantum computers will be unavailable during the upgrade. We will notify you here as soon as the upgrade is done. 

 The IQM OS 4.4. release brings major platform updates, including:

items.content: Python 3.12 support
Qiskit 2.0 and 2.1 support (with deprecation warnings for versions < 2.0)
Client communication now routed through IQM Server (instead of Station Control)
Modernized job and circuit APIs with unified models across software components

data.text: As part of these changes, several endpoint and client API updates require user adaptation:
🔧 IQMClient Changes

items.content: IQMClient now takes iqm_server_url instead of url.
New optional parameter: quantum_computer (needed only if the server hosts multiple devices, which is the case for Resonance).
timeout_secs removed — requests now use the IQM_CLIENT_REQUESTS_TIMEOUT environment variable.
Job and circuit calls now return a CircuitJob object rather than a plain ID.
Use CircuitJob.result, CircuitJob.update, and CircuitJob.wait_for_completion for job handling.
get_run → get_job
get_run_counts → get_job_measurement_counts
abort_job → cancel_job
get_run_status, wait_for_compilation, and wait_for_results → removed (use job methods instead)
Endpoints renamed or replaced:
custom_settings removed from submit_circuits; use Pulla if needed.
New parameter: use_timeslot for selecting timeslot vs. shared on-demand queues.

data.text: 🔧 Pulla Changes

items.content: Now communicates via IQM Server; `station_control_url` replaced with iqm_server_url.
CalibrationSet renamed to CalibrationSetValues, and many APIs updated accordingly (get_calibration_set_values, fetch_default_calibration_set, etc.).
Deprecated methods removed (e.g., execute, fetch_latest_calibration_set, get_token_callback).
Several models removed in favor of shared Station Control interface models.

data.text: These changes ensure a more consistent and maintainable API across the IQM software ecosystem.
Please note: devices will be unavailable on December 8th during the upgrade.
We will notify you once systems are back online.

system_notifications.title: Garnet quantum computer online
system_notifications.lead: 20 qubit QPU returns

data.text: The Garnet quantum computer is available for job submissions again (since 12pm CET 31/10/25). Median CZ fidelity is currently ~ 99.5%. Please use freely and report issues to support@meetiqm.com.

system_notifications.title: IQM Resonance gets a new look
system_notifications.lead: Learn about our new features and sign up for Quantum school

data.text: IQM Resonance updates:
We've given IQM Resonance a fresh new look without changing the core user interface.
We also have a few new features you might find interesting:

items.content: Dynamic heatmap for viewing real-time performance of our Quantum Computers.
Updates page where we'll post updates about major features and possible maintenance breaks.
Starter tier level for accounts for personal use.

data.text: Sign up for IQM Quantum School

We’re committed to contributing to the growing knowledge of quantum computing and in addition to frequent tutorials and learning paths at IQM Academy, we’re launching a 3-day Quantum school for anyone looking to explore quantum.
Sign up now by sending an email to support@meetiqm.com or share the invite if you know someone who might be interested: https://resonance.meetiqm.com/sign-up/quantumschool

system_notifications.title: Garnet quantum computer offline
system_notifications.lead: We are experiencing an unexpected outage of the Garnet quantum computer

data.text: The IQM Garnet quantum computer is currently experiencing technical issues and is therefore offline. The team is working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible and will keep you updated on the status.
